title: lithospermum viridiflorum
intro: Lithospermum viridiflorum, commonly known as Gromwell, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the borage family (Boraginaceae). The health benefits of Gromwell include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various skin conditions and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Lithospermum viridiflorum include its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce swelling, and promote wound healing, making it a popular ingredient in topical creams and ointments. The bioactive constituents of Gromwell include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
